## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1465a85502a330f34ec087527b54020c55c381b7`
Local-runs: probe — offline `--self-test` of validate.mjs (337/17), execute.mjs (276/23), mailbox-open.mjs (85/10) and dispatch.mjs (318/27), all exit 0, in a detached worktree at the head sha under the scratchpad, removed after; no relay, no dispatch, no network write
Scope: (hits) scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs, scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs + (cited, read not reviewed) .github/workflows/fleet-write.yml, scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/rest-channel.md

### ① Derived judgments

- New op row `mailbox_branch_delete` (ops.mjs L2186-2191): `required: ['pull','branch']`, `optional: []`, `permission: 'contents'`, no `alsoSpends`, not `alone`; its one request is `DELETE /repos/REPO/git/refs/heads/BRANCH` with no `body` and a `mailboxBranch` descriptor. Correct: delete-only, one request, rides the close stroke (validate.mjs L1283 pins the close stroke's token as the five literal grants, nothing stroke-scoped).
- New field `branch` (ops.mjs L1809): `str`, `max: MAX_REF_BYTES`, `shape: MAILBOX_BRANCH_SHAPE`, `what` sentence; validate.mjs L336 enforces `shape` with a message that names the shape and never echoes the value. Correct. The shape `/^claude\/mailbox-[a-z0-9]+(?:[._-][a-z0-9]+)*$/` (ops.mjs L1732) admits no second `/`, no `..`, no `%`, no upper case, no space, no empty or trailing-separator slug, so the raw interpolation into the path at L2190 cannot escape `refs/heads/claude/mailbox-`.
- `MAILBOX_LABEL` moved to ops.mjs L1734 and re-exported by mailbox-open.mjs L160 (import L147): one spelling. Correct.
- `REFUSED_PATH_FAMILIES` (ops.mjs L2369-2375): only the `/git/` entry changed, to `new RegExp('/git/(?!refs/heads/' + shape-without-anchors + '$)')` (L2373); `/merge$`, `/pulls/N/reviews`, `/branches/`, `/contents/`, the actions and advisory families are byte-identical. Correct and exactly one path shape. Note: the family list is a construction pin only — grep shows it used solely in validate.mjs self-tests (L1225, L1227, L1281, L1384, L1410, …), never at run time in execute.mjs — so the runtime boundary is the closed op table + closed keys + field shape, re-judged by `validatePayload(raw)` inside `executeFleetWrite` (execute.mjs L1354) before any request.
- `PERMISSIONS` unchanged (validate.mjs L1239 pin unchanged: `contents: 'write'` was already there); `.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml` L136 already mints `permission-contents: write` as a literal input, confirming the dev's "no workflow / PERMISSIONS change". Correct. The validate self-test pins at L1253 / L1254 now name the third `contents` spender and that its one REST request is a DELETE of a head ref.
- execute.mjs: `mailboxBranchFenceFailures` (L911-922, pure), `mailboxBranchPreflight` (L925-933) reads `GET /pulls/PULL` and `GET /pulls?state=open&head=OWNER:BRANCH` fresh under the App token; `confirmMailboxBranch` (L935-941) reads `GET /git/ref/heads/BRANCH` back and lands only on 404, a non-2xx DELETE with an absent ref being an idempotent landing. Wired at L1475 (the `pre` slot, refused rows pushed as `not sent` and the stroke stopped) and L1566 (the landed chain). `requestLanded` (card #30114's site) untouched. Correct.
- mailbox-open.mjs: `planClose({ repo, pull, head = null })` (L296-303) appends `mailbox_branch_delete` last, only when `head` matches the shape (L297, L301); `closeLive` re-plans with the live head after `closeRefusal` (L457-458); dry-run text and the cloud refusal message (L422) now prescribe `--head claude/mailbox-SLUG`. Correct; `closeRefusal` (L346-350) still refuses a non-open or unlabelled pull before anything is sent.
- Self-test floors: validate 16 to 17 (L1027), execute 22 to 23 (L1652); mailbox-open close battery 3 to 5; dispatch.mjs unchanged (its op lists derive from `OP_NAMES`: `BODY_OPS` L942, `RUN_OPS` L945, `CONTENT_CREATING_OPS` L1402; `READ_BACK_LOCATORS` is pinned to exactly `BODY_OPS` at L2414, and the new row carries no body). Consistent.

### ② Semver level

None: `scripts/pm/**` only, no published package or `exports` map touched; `skip-changeset` label on the PR is correct. PR body `Fixes #30350`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` re-derived from the 4-file surface: all correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay-written; no login note owed). Dev deviations, each answered:
- (1) Two extra fences (head repo == this repo, L918; no OPEN pull on that head, L919-920): both narrowing, both inside ruling A's "anything else refused". Accepted.
- (2) No sha fence: see should-fix 1 below; disclosed in the PR body, not a ruling condition.
- (3) Acceptance probe only after merge (relay runs main): true by construction of the relay; the probe's actions file names only #30141 / #30142, both closed and labelled; `mailbox/os-zhuang/triage-1` is outside the shape. Accepted.
- (4) Merge of origin/main rather than rebase: no bearing on the surface.
Out-of-scope findings confirmed: fleet-write.yml L134-135 ("has NO contents op — no file, ref or branch write") becomes false on landing (Tier H, outside the surface; the seat to card it); rest-channel.md holds no full op registry (only prose naming `advisory_read`, `automerge_disable` at L50, L58, L60), so the gap is a doc mention, not a registry failure (Tier S, outside the surface). `open_questions: []`. Head check-runs at 2026-11-06T02:57Z: 23 success, 21 skipped, 1 in progress (Test Core 1/8), 0 red; the seat lands only on all green.

### ④ Design judgment

Must-checks (a)-(i), each against the head:
- (a) Carve-out reachable by one path shape only: the only `/git/` path any row spells is L2190; every other row that interpolates a caller string into a path encodes it (`labels_remove` L2047, `workflow_dispatch` L2195 via `enc`) or shape-validates it (`ghsa_id`), so no row can produce `/git/`. Traversal, `%2F`, `..`, case, empty slug, trailing segment, qualified ref, space: refused by the shape (validate.mjs L1277-1278, twelve names). Tags, trees, blobs, commits, nested refs, the create path `refs`, the singular `ref` path and `/contents/`: still caught (positive control L1227). Other repos: `payload.repo` is `TARGET_REPO_SHAPE` and the head-repo fence (L918). POST/PATCH on the same path: no row (L1225 pins the single `/git/` request as `['mailbox_branch_delete','DELETE',…]`; `ALLOWED_MUTATIONS` L2367 unchanged). PASS.
- (b) All conditions judged server-side on a fresh `GET /pulls/PULL` (L927) and the open-pulls list (L929), the last two reads before the DELETE (L1475 then L1507); the request contributes only `pull` and `branch`. TOCTOU: one runner turn with no sleep between the reads and the DELETE; the read-back (L937) verifies the outcome. Reasoned in both headers (ops.mjs L58-74, execute.mjs L193-202). Acceptable.
- (c) Delete-only: one `DELETE`, no create or move anywhere (L1225, L2367). PASS.
- (d) Loud refusals: validator sentence at L336; each fence names itself at L913-920 and the row is `not sent` with `REFUSED at the relay's fence …` (L932). PASS.
- (e) `--close` sends comment, close, delete in one stroke (L296-303, L457-458); execute.mjs L2547 pins that stroke through the executor: DELETE sent after the PATCH, pull read after the close, last call the ref read back absent. PASS.
- (f) Refusal cases: open pull, no label, other head, forked head, open pull on head, unread pull, unread list (execute L2529-2539); 204-but-present FAILED (L2541); 422-and-absent idempotent (L2543); non-mailbox head closed with nothing under `/git/` (L2549); good case (L2525); twelve bad names (validate L1277-1278); closed keys (L1279). PASS.
- (g) Registries: validate.mjs minimal ledger and three per-op ledgers updated (diff L1172, L1372, L1529, L1796); dispatch.mjs derives; `WIRED_WRITE_TOOLS` (write-pace.mjs L1334-1344) needs no entry because mailbox-open issues no write verb itself (it spawns dispatch.mjs, L380). PASS.
- (h) Only the `/git/` row of `REFUSED_PATH_FAMILIES` changed. PASS.
- (i) No `.github/workflows/**` in the 4-file list; `skip-changeset` correct; body lines correct; surface held. PASS.

Per hits file:
- ops.mjs: the row, the shape, the field and the family carve-out are sound; the carve-out is built from the shape's own source (L2373), so the two cannot drift. One remark: the family regex is method-blind (a PATCH of the same ref path would pass it), which is fine today only because the family is a construction pin and L1225 pins the verb; keep that pin.
- validate.mjs: `shape` honoured only on `str` (L336); refusal names the shape, no echo. Sound.
- execute.mjs: fences and read-back sound; the label fence is an accident guard rather than a privilege guard, since the same write-permitted sender can `labels_add` + `issue_patch` in the same stroke, so the effective boundary is "head of a closed pull, named `claude/mailbox-*`, on this repo, with no open pull on it", which is what ruling A asked for.
- mailbox-open.mjs: `planClose` keeps the delete last; the dry run reads nothing and says the delete rides conditionally. Sound.

should-fix 1: no sha fence (execute.mjs L911-922). A closed `pm:mailbox` pull is a permanent licence to delete whatever `claude/mailbox-SLUG` later holds, as long as no OPEN pull has that head; commits force-pushed to that name after close, with no pull on them, would be deleted. Blast radius is bounded to a name mailbox-open reserves for empty-commit mailbox heads (L79-80, L422), so not a must-fix, but one extra fence (`GET /git/ref/heads/BRANCH` before the DELETE, object sha == pull `head.sha`, else refuse) would make "that PR's head" literal and cost one read.
should-fix 2: proportion vs card #29471 (net +167): code is proportionate to the ruling's pins, but the fence list is restated in prose four times (ops.mjs L58-74, the PERMISSIONS doc-comment, execute.mjs L193-202, mailbox-open.mjs L98-103); keep one and point at it.
should-fix 3: if the relay's `GET /pulls/PULL` lags the `PATCH` close of the same stroke, the fence refuses, the pull is already closed and `closeRefusal` (L346-349) then refuses a re-run of `--close`, leaving exactly the leftover the card is about; have the failure path name the bare-actions remedy (one `mailbox_branch_delete` action via dispatch.mjs).

- Sha fence (execute.mjs L906-920): `mailboxBranchFenceFailures` now takes a `ref` answer; `at` is `object.sha` only when the answer is 200 AND its `ref` equals `refs/heads/BRANCH` exactly (L916), so a prefix-matched or malformed answer yields no sha; any non-404 answer without a string sha is refused as unread (L917); any non-404 answer whose sha differs from the pull's `head.sha` is refused by name (L918), an unread `head.sha` included (`at !== undefined`). It cannot delete anything that existed at the pre-read; the only exposure is a ref created inside the preflight-to-DELETE window, which is the same CAS-less window every fence here has (GitHub's ref DELETE takes no precondition), and the name space is the mailbox one. ## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:按你裁的 #30350 A,中继新增一个只删不建的操作 `mailbox_branch_delete`:只删一个已关闭、带 `pm:mailbox` 标签的 PR 的 head 分支,分支名必须是 `claude/mailbox-*`、在本仓、没有开着的 PR 用它,且分支当前的提交必须正是那个 PR 的 head(关闭后再推的提交不删)。`mailbox-open --close` 关信箱时同笔调用,关完不留分支。
- 为什么改:云端席位关信箱后分支删不掉,每坐一次云席就多一个永不清理的 `claude/` 分支,预检还会把它读成认领;目前远端已有 3 个。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `scripts/pm/` 4 个文件,工作流权限不变(删分支只需已有的 `contents: write`);`REFUSED_PATH_FAMILIES` 只在 `/git/` 一行放开这一种路径,其余全部原样。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs` 头注(围栏清单只写在这一处)和 `execute.mjs` 的 `mailboxBranchFenceFailures`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs --self-test`,预期通过,含移动过的分支、读不到的分支等拒绝用例。
- 需要你做的:无。`scripts/pm/**` 不在受管面,复核 PASS(6675668758),补 sha 围栏后增量复核 PASS(6676124965),席位直接入自动合并。合并后席位用新操作删掉现存的两个残留信箱分支做验收。
- 席位意见:可合。代码净增约 +186 行,#29471 的「scripts/pm 净减」这次没做到,复核认为与裁决要求的围栏相称。
